name: paired-minds-look-ten-two-horses-reveal-second-first-goes-bottom
notes: Paired Minds, Kindred Souls (7qjnqww067): two Horse allies in the top ten (Caretaker Horse 3rd, Ordinary Horse 8th). Both are offered; the 8th is revealed to hand and the 3rd goes to the bottom with the other eight.

rulesClauses: Look at the top ten cards of your deck. Reveal a Horse ally card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Two defects. (1) The generated cardActivatedAbilities["7qjnqww067:0"] body looked at the top ten cards with a loop of MZMove($player, "myDeck-0", "myTempZone"): Remove() only flags a slot removed (no splice), so "myDeck-0" resolved to the SAME removed slot on every iteration after the first and MZMove's "already removed" guard silently no-oped -- only the top card was ever looked at (live repro on HEAD: the Horse in slot 7 was never offered, no prompt, one card to the bottom, deck 24). The generated file cannot be edited (gitignored), so the closure is overridden in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php with MZMoveTopOfZone(). (2) PairedMindsFinish() put the remaining cards on the bottom with a loop of MZMove($player, "myTempZone-0", "myDeck"): the same removed-slot problem moved only the first remaining card and left the rest stranded in myTempZone. Fixed with MZMoveTopOfZone().
